note: Both sets capture the core Cooking thresholds (5.000 lb / 80 oz / 2.268 kg for full points, 1.000–5.000 lb reduced, ≤16 oz no points) and the 96.00 oz starting-water minimum, and both repeat the same facts many times. Set A additionally gets the dinner-party facts right (two parties per team, two guests per neighboring house, 0–100% percentage scores), but it contains one substantive misread: it claims an eight-person guest list 'per neighboring house' and backs it with a fabricated quote, when the rule limits the whole party to eight people (two from each of three houses plus up to two VIPs). Set B avoids that error and adds correct neighborhood (four houses) and VIP (up to two) facts, but it misbinds the 96.00 oz rule to an invented 'Home Entertainment Contest 9' condition and uses the Figure 9 caption as a quote for claims it does not support. Both sets also share weak or invented figure quotes, so the margin is modest.
